name: Fish pie (about 1 hour 15 minutes)
title: Fish pie

steps.text: Oven on: 200C, 180C fan, gas 6. Peel the potatoes and cut into chunks.
Potatoes into a pan of cold salted water. Bring to the boil. Cook 15 to 18 minutes until soft.
Fish and prawns into a pan with the almond milk. Heat gently 4 minutes until the fish just turns opaque. Do not boil hard. Lift the fish out onto a plate. Keep the milk.

Warning: the sauce can go lumpy. Stir all the time. Mix the cornflour with 4 tbsp of the kept milk. Heat the rest of the milk until it steams. Stir the cornflour mix in. Keep stirring 2 minutes until thick.
Stir in the parsley, a squeeze of lemon, salt and pepper. Flake the fish into the sauce with the peas. Mix gently. Tip into an ovenproof dish.
Potatoes soft when a knife goes in easily. Drain them. Mash with 2 tbsp olive oil and a splash of almond milk. Season. Tap DONE.
Spoon the mash over the fish. Rough the top with a fork. Sprinkle cheese on the others' side only.
Into the oven for 30 minutes until golden and bubbling.
Check the top is golden. Put on the grill for 3 minutes if it needs colour.
Warning: dish is hot. Take it out. Leave to stand 5 minutes.

prep: Fish pie mix and prawns out of the fridge
shopping: 400 g fish pie mix (salmon, smoked haddock, cod)
cheddar for the others only (one person avoids dairy)
equipment: a wide pan for the fish
